figures.caption: xStAx-VHLL promotes the proteasomal degradation of β-catenin.a The amino acid sequence of the designed peptides. b HEK293T cells were treated with Wnt3a conditioned medium (CM), the vehicle (DMSO) or various peptides (70 μM) as indicated for 24 h and then harvested for immunoblotting.
